newsitem.title: USA: Uno Restaurant sees Q1 shr $0.07 to $0.08.
newsitem.headline: Uno Restaurant sees Q1 shr $0.07 to $0.08.

text.p: Uno Restaurant Corp said Tuesday it expects net income for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 ending December 31 to be around $900,000 to $1,000,000, or $0.07 to $0.08 per share.
This compares with net income of $545,000, or $0.04 per share, for the first quarter last year.
Revenue for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 is expected to increase to approximately $43.0 million from $40.6 million for the same period last year, the company said.
Uno operates 86 Pizzeria Uno restaurants and franchises 64 units in 19 U.S. states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico and Canada.
